narr: Widespread showers and thunderstorms produced locally heavy rain in southeastern Pennsylvania on the afternoon of July 25. Rainfall amounts were as high as 2.0 to 3.5 inches.
ev: Widespread roadway flooding occurred in West Pikeland Township with several roads becoming impassable. Pickering Creek overflowed its banks resulting in roadway flooding around Jacques Circle.

Moderate to major flooding occurred along the East Branch of the Brandywine Creek in West Bradford Township and East Bradford Township. The flooding resulted in the closure of a section of US Route 322.
Several roads in Marlborough Township became impassable due to flooding. Macoby Creek overflowed its banks, causing flooding along McLean Station Road.
Flooding occurred along PA Route 291 in Chester. Several vehicles became trapped in the flood waters, necessitating some water rescues.
Widespread roadway flooding and road closures in Upper Uwchlan Township, including PA Route 100 near the Pennsylvania Turnpike.
A vehicle became trapped in flood waters at the intersection of Uwchlan Avenue and Sheree Boulevard in Uwchlan Township, necessitating a water rescue.
Widespread roadway flooding and road closures occurred in West Whiteland Township, with multiple water rescues taking place.
Creek Road was closed due to flooding in East Brandywine Township and in Caln Township, between Dowlin Forge Road and Norwood Road.
Widespread roadway flooding and road closures occurred in East Whiteland Township, with at least one water rescue taking place.
Minor flooding occurred along French Creek in Phoenixville.
lsr: Trained Spotter relays report of street flooding on Route 201 with ongoing water rescues and people stuck in cars.
Several photos of several roads completely impassible with a creek overflowing its banks near McLean Station Rd in Red Hill. Time estimated.
Water rescue reported at the intersection of Uwchlan Avenue and Sheree Boulevard.
Public reports multiple road closures in Upper Uwchlan Township including Route 100 near the Pennsylvania Turnpike.
911 call center reports multiple water rescues in West Whiteland Township.
911 Call Center reports water rescue in East Whiteland Township.
